ztb.evaluation.auto_feature_generator module

Feature auto-generation utilities.

This module provides automatic generation of technical indicators with standardized na if fast_periods is None:

fast_periods = self.params.get(‘kama’, {}).get(‘fast_periods’, [5, 10])

if slow_periods is None:

slow_periods = self.params.get(‘kama’, {}).get(‘slow_periods’, [20, 30])

if efficiency_periods is None:

efficiency_periods = self.params.get(‘kama’, {}).get(‘efficiency_periods’, [10, 20, 30, 50])

# Ensure we have valid lists assert isinstance(fast_periods, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in fast_periods) assert isinstance(slow_periods, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in slow_periods) assert isinstance(efficiency_periods, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in efficiency_periods)nd promotion rules.

Backtest Comparison: v381 (110 features) vs v384 (68 curated features)

Tests both models on historical BTC/JPY market data to compare: 1. Trading performance (PnL, Sharpe ratio) 2. Action distribution (HOLD/BUY/SELL balance) 3. Risk metrics (max drawdown, win rate)

ztb.evaluation.runner module

Integrated comprehensive evaluation runner.

This script runs the complete evaluation pipeline: 1. Feature evaluation (–evaluate) 2. Correlation analysis (–correlate) 3. Lag correlation analysis (–lag) 4. Benchmark generation (–benchmark) 5. Weekly report generation (–report)

Use –all to run the complete pipeline.
